message: @unique on field "User.email" has the same fields, with the same sort, as @@unique([email]) on model "User". Prisma 6 refuses this: "Index already exists in the model." Remove one of them.
@@unique([email]) on model "User" has the same fields, with the same sort, as @unique on field "User.email". Prisma 6 refuses this: "Index already exists in the model." Remove one of them.

@@index([name]) on model "User" and @@index([name(sort: Asc)]) on model "User" are the same index, with the same keys and options, in collection "User". MongoDB cannot hold two identical indexes in one collection. Remove one of them.
